the source-pad field sits over the tile footprint (the pad model's own geometric capacity), so 1 V leaves the package directly above each cell; the in-tile collection is owned by P_intraVR_metal (R2 output plane) and the lateral spreading beyond the tile happens in the die's power grid, outside package scope. The alternative -- pads spread over the whole unit cell -- is quantified in the sensitivity block
